title: TEKEX AI Sprint Guernsey
label: AI Sprint
strap: AI in business and the local community.
description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we learn, work, make decisions and deliver services. This TEKEX AI Sprint event brings business leaders, industry experts and young talent from across the Crown Dependencies together.

The evening explores how AI is transforming education, business, public services and healthcare, and the risks, misconceptions and ethical questions that come with it. A panel takes on the biggest AI opportunities of the next five years, the key risks and misconceptions, the ethics, and the impact on work and education; a closing fireside chat draws the themes together.
Part of the Guernsey AI Sprint, six weeks of events across the island from 1 October to 12 November, led by the G8. Open to anyone interested in AI’s impact on business and the community.

title: TEKEX IOM3
strap: Global Innovation. Isle of Man Opportunity.
description: TEKEX is back in the Isle of Man, this time to identify global innovations that could become valuable Isle of Man opportunities, then connect each one with the local investment, partners and decision-makers required to launch it.

Jason Bissell, exited founder and now entrepreneur, will be speaking on Innovation Islands and what’s next for the Crown. Mark Sutcliffe will deliver the keynote on connecting ambitious innovation with agile jurisdictions, in his talk ‘The Billion Dollar Exit to Building in the Crown’.
You'll also see a panel debate and have the chance to put your questions to founders.

There'll be a live jam session on stage with local musicians and all-round good vibes after our Good Vibes hack session.

title: TEKEX #36
strap: Showcasing on and off island innovators breaking boundaries and turning heads.
description: Get ready for an awesome in-person experience at TEKEX 36. It's the perfect chance to connect, learn, and witness game changers and passionistas.
Our line-up is once again a colourful blend of founders, some in fundraise stage and one whose product has 20 million users.

title: TEKEX IOM2
strap: The in-person tech meetup where innovation meets fresh ideas.
description: TEKEX IoM 2 is where innovators, makers and tech lovers come together to share ideas, create projects and network. Whether you're a newbie or a pro, it's all about learning, collaborating and having fun.

title: TEKEX #35: Female Founders
strap: Round two of our female founder event, showcasing the islands' innovators and connected founders.
description: Our second Female Founder event, in collaboration with Alt Collective, with a dynamic line-up of founders and leaders. Alt Collective hosted, with an introduction from compère Sophie Clyde-Smith, streaming across both Guernsey and Jersey.

title: TEKEX IOM1: Isle of Man launch
strap: Our inaugural Isle of Man launch: innovation, incubation and investment.
description: The launch of TEKEX in the Isle of Man: an innovation community connecting investors, founders and professionals across the Crown Dependencies.

Jayne Sibley's Sibstar won Dragons' Den and Sara Davies as an investor, and has already raised successfully through TEKEX. Shelley Langan-Newton, a founder superstar in the Isle of Man, joined our stage as SQR entered its funding round. Tim Huelin, another successful Jersey-based founder, has built Daysium (‘Count your Days’) through our network.
Ticket fees went to Manx Decaf and Forget Me Not IoM, given Sibstar's support for people living with dementia.

title: TEKEX #34
strap: Our last headline event of 2025, with on and off island innovators tearing up the rule books.
description: An incredible line-up of speakers and an open and honest AI debate, The Great DebAIte, with Oliver Farber, Nyxie Redondo, Gus Fraser, Charlie Morgan, Rory Steel and more.

title: TEKEX #33
strap: Tans completed. Kids back at school. Now let's get back at it.
description: Our usual format: six speakers, a strict ten-minute presentation each, followed by Q&A, live-streamed between the C5 hubs in Jersey and Guernsey.

Hanna Roos: “We give power back to clients, and joy back to lawyers.” Aavalynx combines AI with human legal expertise to make dispute resolution faster, cheaper and more human. George McLeod asked about “The £3 Trillion Blind Spot: Reinventing Trusts for the 99%”, and Andy Lowe presented his first breakout film.

title: TEKEX #32
strap: Three speakers in Guernsey and three in Jersey, streamed to each island.
description: A melting pot of talent, founders and innovators from both islands, plus government updates on business support: Guernsey's GEIS scheme (Sasha Kazantseva) and the Better Business Support Scheme (Paul Murphy).

Headliners included Summit Deals, a new investor platform housing some of TEKEX's opportunities and investors; machine learning against the Channel Islands' skin-cancer rate, the highest in the British Isles; and how the microbiome can be harnessed for health.

lineup.name: Jonathan Roos
lineup.talk: Turning the skin cancer tide in Jersey

title: TEKEX #31
strap: Off and on island speakers, from space to finance and film to geopolitics.
description: An evening of founder talks and networking, with off and on island speakers covering everything from space to finance and film to geopolitics.

title: TEKEX #30: Female Founders
strap: Celebrating female founders, from fintech to UX.
description: This edition celebrated female founders from fintech to UX, to a capacity audience.

title: TEKEX #29
strap: Payments, paws, private equity and, of course, AI.
description: Swagger Paws, a Jersey-based e-commerce company built for dog walkers by dog walkers, looking for its next phase of growth. Jake Schofield on the highs, lows and lessons of creating and exiting a health-tech start-up.

Then the most common pinch point at TEKEX, payments, with Robert Crutchington on how Jersey can benefit from an independent payment gateway, David Parkinson on Bitcoin and a multi-planetary future, and Seb Lawson on AI and education in the workplace.
